recurse.description: Recursively operate on subdirectories within the same filesystem (-r).

convert.description: Convert absolute links to relative links and clean up messy/lengthy links (-c).

detect_lengthy.description: Detect lengthy links that use '../' more than necessary (-s).

remove_dangling.description: Remove symbolic links whose target does not exist (-d).

fix_other_fs.description: Fix links on other filesystems encountered while recursing (-o).

verbose.description: Show all symbolic links, including relative ones (-v).

scan_dirs.description: List of directory paths to scan for symbolic links.
